text:
emma (Finance): Heads-up: our daily cost report flagged ~14k GPU-hours in `shared-gpu` with team=unassigned for Aug. Need to figure owner mapping before showback.
cost-bot: Alert: gpu-unattributed | pool=shared-gpu | window=30d | unassigned_hours=14024 | est_cost=33,200 USD | link=https://alerts.redwood/ccr-555 :rotating_light:
julio (SRE): Ouch. Could be transient test clusters not tagging correctly. We had a CI change pushing instances without `team` label on 2024-08-02.
priya (Eng-Infra): I remember that rollout. There was a metadata->labels refactor. I'll check the PR and instance template history.
marc (DataPlatform): I'll run a narrow attribution query to list affected instance IDs and creation projects. Quick BQ: ```SELECT instance_id, project, labels, SUM(gpu_hours) as hrs FROM billing.gpu_usage WHERE pool='shared-gpu' AND DATE(usage_start) BETWEEN '2024-08-01' AND '2024-08-31' AND (labels.team IS NULL OR labels.team='') GROUP BY instance_id, project, labels ORDER BY hrs DESC LIMIT 200```
emma (Finance): If this maps back to specific customers we need to credit them; if internal tests, chargeback to eng budgets. Please post CSV.
priya (Eng-Infra): Found template v5.1 rolled 2024-08-02 that dropped `labels.team` for preemptible groups. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1621. Reverting now.
julio (SRE): I'll mute alert for 12h while we investigate.
cost-bot: Alert muted by julio (SRE) for 12 hours on #finance.
marc (DataPlatform): CSV uploaded: https://storage.redwood/finance/unattributed-sharedgpu-1850345600.csv total_unattributed_hours=14024 total_est_cost=33200 breakdown top3 projects: projects/ci-infra (6000h), projects/partner-trials (4200h), projects/internal-tests (3824h)
emma (Finance): Good breakdown. Action plan: 1) priya revert template + add label-presence CI gate (due: 2024-09-02 EOD). 2) marc run attribution backfill for Aug and produce corrected ledger (due: 2024-09-03 10:00). 3) julio confirm whether CI jobs should be charged to eng or considered free test credits (due: 2024-09-03 noon). Finance will withhold reallocation until backfill completes.
priya (Eng-Infra): Revert PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1627 ETA rollout 2h. Adding e2e to fail on missing `team` label.
marc (DataPlatform): Backfill job started: `bq query --use_legacy_sql=false '...write to billing.attribution_backfill_1850345600'` job id=bfill-1850.
julio (SRE): CI team confirms most CI runs should be charged to projects/ci-infra; they accept chargeback. For partner trials, partnerships to verify if credits apply.
emma (Finance): Partnerships will need to confirm partner trial credit coverage. If partner-trials are eligible, we must reassign costs. Marc, include partner tag suggestions in CSV.
marc (DataPlatform): Backfill finished. New ledger delta: allocated 14024h -> ci-infra:6000h, partner-trials:4200h, internal-tests:3824h. Updated CSV: https://storage.redwood/finance/unattributed-sharedgpu-backfill-1850345600.csv
emma (Finance): Perfect. I'll update showback and notify teams. Closing loop: priya follow-up to prevent recurrence; julio please re-open alert if unlabeled hours >2k in 24h. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
